q: Popa's cocycle superrigidity theorem (2005) proves that for certain group actions (malleable, property (T) or strong property (T)), any measurable cocycle into a target group Λ is:
opts: Cohomologous to a group homomorphism (the cocycle is 'rigidly' determined by algebraic data)
exp: Popa's superrigidity: cocycles c: Γ×X→Λ for Bernoulli Γ-actions are cohomologous to group homomorphisms Γ→Λ. This is the cocycle version of Margulis superrigidity — cocycles (derivatives of orbit equivalences) are algebraically constrained.
